skill.name: fal-platform
skill.description: Guidance for planning fal platform API tasks involving model management, pricing review, and usage tracking.
skill.summary: Plan fal platform API work for model, pricing, and usage operations.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The skill is a prompt-only guidance document with no executable code. The two hardcoded URL findings are documentation links to the upstream source, and no prompt injection or malicious intent was found.

finding_verdicts.reason: The URL is a source metadata link in SKILL.md frontmatter, not a network request or executable behavior. The skill contains no code path that contacts the URL.
The URL is a markdown source repository reference for user documentation. It does not trigger network access or transmit data.

content.value_statement: Teams need concise guidance for fal platform API tasks across models, pricing, and usage. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code frame platform API requests and planning steps.
actual_capabilities: Provides guidance for fal platform API work involving model management, pricing, and usage tracking.
Helps users decide when fal platform API planning is relevant to a task.
Frames prompts around model operations, pricing review, and usage analysis.
Supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as a prompt-only reference skill.
Links users to the upstream fal platform skill source for more detail.
limitations: Does not execute API requests or manage fal resources by itself.
Does not include authentication setup, SDK examples, or endpoint definitions.
Does not validate pricing or usage data against live fal.ai systems.
Depends on the user to provide current project context and API details.

use_cases.title: Plan Model Operations
use_cases.description: Create a clear task plan for managing fal models, owners, and operational requirements.

use_cases.title: Review Pricing Impact
use_cases.description: Prepare questions and checks before estimating platform cost for a model feature.

use_cases.title: Track Usage Workflows
use_cases.description: Organize usage tracking needs before building reports or operational reviews.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Basic Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the fal-platform skill. Help me outline a task plan for managing models, pricing, or usage tracking in my fal project.

prompt_templates.title: Clarify API Needs
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the fal-platform skill. Ask me the key questions needed to choose between model management, pricing review, and usage tracking work.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an API Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the fal-platform skill. Create a workflow for a fal platform API task, including inputs, checks, expected outputs, and review steps.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Platform Operations
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the fal-platform skill. Review my planned fal platform operations for missing pricing, usage, ownership, and model management considerations.

output_examples.input: I need to track fal usage for a team project.
output_examples.output: A planning checklist covering usage metrics, account scope, reporting cadence, data owners, and validation questions.

output_examples.input: I need to review pricing before launching a model feature.
output_examples.output: A structured review plan that separates pricing assumptions, usage estimates, cost risks, and follow-up questions.

output_examples.input: I need to organize model management work for a fal deployment.
output_examples.output: A task outline covering model inventory, ownership, access needs, operational checks, and documentation updates.

best_practices: Provide the model, account scope, and business goal before asking for platform guidance.
Separate pricing assumptions from verified pricing data in every planning output.
Confirm live API behavior against official fal documentation before implementation.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the skill as a live API client or data source.
Do not paste secrets, API keys, or private account data into prompts.
Do not use stale pricing or usage assumptions without verification.

faq.question: Does this skill call the fal API?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and planning patterns only.

faq.question: Can it manage models directly?
faq.answer: No. It can help plan model management tasks, but it does not perform changes.

faq.question: Does it provide current pricing?
faq.answer: No. Verify current pricing with official fal sources before making decisions.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide your task goal, model context, account scope, and any known usage requirements.

faq.question: Is it suitable for production planning?
faq.answer: Yes, for planning support. Production actions should use verified API documentation and approved credentials.
